title: App Store previews: three App Previews from real build-284 screen recordings
brief: Three App Previews for the screenshot row (iPhone 6.9"/6.5", 886 × 1920, 15–30 s, 30 fps), one feature each, cut from real screen recordings of build 284 (the new look) through the dev probes, with S-V3's two-tone Geist headline on its linen ground and Apple's iPhone bezel straight on. 1 Your closet, from your photos (Extract all) · 2 See it on you, before you wear it (Try-ons) · 3 Always know what to wear (Today, then Chat).
hook: The first frame: the headline already up and the app already moving in the phone (the scan's photos sorting, her photo whole-screen, Today's look); previews autoplay muted.
